# ProWater

> Piped centralised RO-purified water on subscription for housing societies in Bangalore, India.

ProWater installs and maintains a centralised Reverse Osmosis (RO) water purification plant inside a housing society at **zero cost** to the society or RWA. Individual residents then subscribe to receive pure, piped drinking water delivered directly to their kitchen taps. Plans start from ₹299/month.

## What ProWater Does

- **Centralised RO Plant**: ProWater funds, installs, and owns the entire RO system — piping, plant, and dispensers. The society pays nothing upfront, ever.
- **Piped to Your Tap**: Purified water flows directly to the subscriber's kitchen tap. No cans, no canisters, no trips to a filling station.
- **Live IoT Quality Monitoring**: Real-time water quality data (TDS, bacteria levels, pH) is tracked via IoT sensors and accessible to residents.
- **Lifetime Free Maintenance (AMC)**: All filter replacements, repairs, and servicing are covered at zero additional cost for active subscribers, with a same-day SLA.
- **Individual Subscriptions**: There is no society-wide mandate. Each flat subscribes independently and can join or cancel at any time.

## Plans & Pricing

| Plan      | Price/month | Best For                  |
|-----------|-------------|---------------------------|
| Essential | ₹299        | Single-person households  |
| Family    | ₹399        | Families up to 4 members  |
| Premium   | ₹499        | Larger families, priority |

All plans include unlimited piped RO water and lifetime free AMC.

## Key Facts

- **Societies served**: 50+ across Bangalore
- **Coverage**: Bengaluru (HSR Layout, Koramangala, Whitefield, Sarjapur, Bellandur, Electronic City, and surrounding areas)
- **Water standard**: Purified to WHO & BIS drinking water norms; TDS maintained between 50–150 ppm
- **No plastic waste**: Eliminates dependency on 20-litre water cans
- **No setup cost**: ₹0 to the society or RWA for installation or infrastructure

## Why Societies Choose ProWater

1. Eliminates the need for individual apartment water purifiers (no more ₹15,000–₹30,000 purifier purchases or annual AMC contracts)
2. Saves ₹300–₹700/month per household compared to 20-litre water cans
3. RWA gets a premium amenity with zero capital outlay
4. Reduces plastic bottle waste and carbon footprint for the community
